title: Job application discussed but not submitted
purpose: 'Discussed' is not 'achieved': the website was down, nothing was submitted.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 0
transcript.text: This week we were going to submit the grocery store application.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: The website was down so I couldn't send it.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 0
transcript.text: Let's practice interview questions instead. Tell me about a time you helped someone.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: I helped my neighbor carry boxes when she moved.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 0
transcript.text: That's a good answer; next time add what you learned.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 0
transcript.text: We will try the application again on Thursday.
